notes:
ROUTE TABLE (lib/main.dart:1227-1260, initialRoute '/'):
'/' -> _Root (ServersScreen when conn.profile == null or the profile requiresPasswordReentry/requiresCodexTokenReentry; HomeScreen when conn.hasConnectedServer; else the root-connecting card)
'/servers' -> ServersScreen (RouteSettings.arguments 'edit-active' opens the active profile editor)
'/home' -> HomeScreen
'/activity' -> ActivityScreen(controller)
'/requests' -> ActivityScreen(controller) (legacy deep link alias)
'/guide' -> GuideScreen(embedded: false)
'/about' -> AboutScreen
'/termux-setup' -> TermuxSetupScreen — registered only if platformCapabilities.supportsTermux
'/debug' -> AppDiagnosticsScreen(controller)
onGenerateRoute: '/chat/<sessionID>' -> ChatScreen(sessionID, discardIfUntouched: arguments is ChatRouteArguments && arguments.discardIfUntouched); any other name -> null
Unregistered route name used only for top-of-stack tracking: '/activity/launch' (main.dart:665, pushed as MaterialPageRoute of ActivityScreen)

main.dart opens no showDialog/showModalBottomSheet itself. Its surfaces are two MaterialBanners (share-session-failed-banner main.dart:427, session-link-server-missing-banner main.dart:925) and action-less snackbars via _messengerKey: shareWaitingForServer (367), _showLaunchNotice (693) with launchShortcutWaiting / launchUiSessionWaiting / launchShortcutNoServer / launchShortcutReentry / launchShortcutConnectionFailed / launchShortcutNewTaskFailed / launchUiSessionNoServer / launchUiSessionOtherServer / launchUiSessionReentry / launchUiSessionConnectionFailed / launchUiActivityNoServer / handoffUiLinkWaiting / handoffUiLinkReentry / handoffUiLinkConnectionFailed, quotaMonitorSourceChanged (991), monitorOpenFailed (1021), new-session failure productErrorText (1066).

MaterialApp.builder wrapper order (main.dart:1171-1209): Theme(AppTheme.forLocale) > MediaQuery(text scale capped at AppTheme.maxTextScale) > ShorebirdUpdateNotice > DesktopReleaseNotice > AppShortcuts > navigator child.

page 'system-entry' is a synthetic overlay page added so system-triggered edges into pages owned by other agents (ChatScreen, ServersScreen, QuotaMonitorScreen, RunScreen, openMonitoredRequest) carry a resolvable targetWidget; coordinator may fold its elements into those pages' reachedFrom as {page:'system'}.

ActivityScreen embeds ProfileMonitorInbox(controller, compact: true) (lib/ui/screens/profile_monitor_screen.dart, owned by g-servers) at activity_screen.dart:595 and :648; its interactive elements are not recorded here.

CompletionDigestCard (lib/ui/widgets/completion_digest.dart, owned by d-chat-sheets) also has a 'Copy digest' button (line ~84-102, clipboard + snackbar) that is internal to the widget; only the four host callbacks are recorded on 'activity'.
activity-digest-review has four possible targets chosen at runtime (activity_screen.dart:126-156); target is set to the first (permission-sheet) and the rest are listed in targetWidget.
TeamReceiptChip onOpen on Activity gate rows (activity_screen.dart:868) is folded into activity-team-gate-row; widget is in lib/ui/widgets/team_receipt.dart (i1-team-core).

ShortcutHelp lists shortcuts not bound in shortcuts.dart (Mod+Enter send, Mod+C copy transcript, F2/Shift+F2 recent model, context keys): they live in chat/composer code owned by other agents (shortcuts.dart:121-129).

Hard-coded English strings (not in app_en.arb): 'Try again' and 'Report a bug' in ProductErrorState (product_states.dart:242,252), 'Requires an OpenCode N server' (product_states.dart:410), 'Drop to attach' (file_drop.dart:133), desktop release snackbar + 'View' (desktop_release_check.dart:245-247), Shorebird snackbars + 'Got it' (shorebird_update_notice.dart:140,156-157), MaterialApp title 'OpenCode Mobile', fallback profile name 'OpenCode' (home_screen.dart:183).
No in-app caller of pushNamed('/activity'), '/requests' or '/home'-with-initialTab was found; HomeScreen.initialTab is only ever the default 0 in lib/.
CapabilitiesScreen tab bodies are other agents' screens in embedded mode; element targets use the '<owner>-<tab>-tab' naming and targetWidget for resolution.

slice P1.3/P1.5 (2026-09-27): the route table's '/termux-setup' (TermuxSetupScreen) is replaced by '/this-phone' (ThisPhoneScreen, still Android only); root-connecting's Termux action goes to This phone or phone setup, and its in-app 'Open setup' goes to phone setup start.
